function largeDomCase(v) {
 let value;for(let i=0;i<200;i++)value=document.querySelector('.entry').textContent;
 const snapshot=document.querySelectorAll('.entry'),first=snapshot[0],last=snapshot.item(4999);
 first.textContent='updated-'+v;first.id='changed';
 const changed=document.getElementById('changed').textContent,keys=Array.from(snapshot.keys()).length;
 first.remove();
 return {value,changed,count:snapshot.length,keys,retained:snapshot[0]===first,remaining:document.querySelectorAll('.entry').length,last:last.textContent};
}
function largeLiveChildrenCase() {
 const parent=document.querySelector('ul'),elements=parent.children,children=parent.childNodes;
 const checks={counts:elements.length===5000 && children.length===5000,
  collections:parent.children===elements && parent.childNodes===children};
 const first=elements[0],last=elements.item(4999);
 checks.first=first===parent.firstElementChild && first===children.item(0);
 checks.last=last===parent.lastElementChild && last===children[4999];
 first.remove();
 checks.removal=elements.length===4999 && children.length===4999 && elements[0]===children[0];
 parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode('tail'));
 checks.text=elements.length===4999 && children.length===5000 && children[4999].nodeType===3;
 parent.appendChild(first);
 checks.insertion=elements.length===5000 && children.length===5001 && elements[4999]===first && children[5000]===first;
 checks.retained=first.parentNode===parent && last===elements[4998];
 return checks;
}
function collectionIterationCase() {
 const checks={},large=document.createElement('div');large.innerHTML='<i></i>'.repeat(1000);
 let seen=0;for(const child of large.children)seen++;
 checks.large=seen===1000;
 let keys=0;for(const key of large.childNodes.keys())keys++;
 checks.keys=keys===1000;
 seen=0;large.childNodes.forEach(()=>seen++);checks.forEach=seen===1000;
 const parent=document.createElement('div');
 const reset=()=>{parent.innerHTML='<i id=a></i><i id=b></i><i id=c></i>';};
 reset();const visited=[];
 for(const child of parent.children){visited.push(child.id);if(visited.length===1)parent.insertBefore(document.createElement('i'),parent.firstChild);}
 checks.prepend=visited.join(',')==='a,a,b,c';
 reset();const values=[];
 parent.childNodes.forEach((child,index)=>{values.push(child.id);if(index===0){child.remove();const next=document.createElement('i');next.id='d';parent.appendChild(next);}});
 checks.callback=values.join(',')==='a,c,d';
 reset();const entries=parent.childNodes.entries(),first=entries.next().value;parent.firstChild.remove();
 const second=entries.next().value;checks.entries=first[0]===0 && first[1].id==='a' && second[0]===1 && second[1].id==='c' && entries.next().done;
 reset();const snapshot=parent.querySelectorAll('i'),staticNames=[];
 for(const child of snapshot){staticNames.push(child.id);child.remove();}
 checks.snapshot=staticNames.join(',')==='a,b,c' && parent.children.length===0;
 reset();const tagged=[];
 for(const child of parent.getElementsByTagName('i')){tagged.push(child.id);if(tagged.length===1){const next=document.createElement('i');next.id='d';parent.appendChild(next);}}
 checks.tags=tagged.join(',')==='a,b,c,d';
 const attrOwner=document.createElement('i');for(const name of ['a','b','c'])attrOwner.setAttribute(name,name);
 const attrs=attrOwner.attributes[Symbol.iterator]();attrs.next();attrOwner.removeAttribute('a');attrOwner.setAttribute('d','d');
 checks.attributes=Array.from(attrs).map(attr=>attr.name).join(',')==='c,d';
 const root=document.createElement('div').attachShadow({mode:'open'});root.innerHTML='<i id=a></i><i id=b></i>';
 const shadow=root.children[Symbol.iterator]();shadow.next();root.firstChild.remove();
 checks.shadow=shadow.next().done;
 const other=document.implementation.createDocument(null,'root'),area=other.documentElement;
 area.appendChild(other.createElementNS(null,'a'));area.appendChild(other.createElementNS(null,'b'));
 const xml=area.children[Symbol.iterator]();xml.next();area.removeChild(area.firstChild);
 checks.xml=xml.next().done;
 return checks;
}
